resources.string: Your runs, with the detail behind them.\n\nConnect Garmin to bring your recent runs into Stride, including routes, splits and heart-rate detail. Stride checks Garmin for updates in the background and keeps a copy on this phone.
Paste the key Garmin showed you
Open Garmin to create a key
Garmin is not connected. Stride still works with the runs already on this phone.
Garmin is connected. Stride pulls in the background and keeps a copy on this phone.
That does not look like a Garmin key. Copy the whole thing.
Garmin did not accept this key. Check that you copied the whole key, or create a new one in Garmin Connect. Your key has not been saved.
Connected. Stride is importing your runs and wellness now.
Disconnected. Your imported runs are still on this phone.
There is no browser on this phone to open Garmin.

Your key stays on this phone. Stride sends it directly to Garmin to get a short-lived access token, and never to Stride\'s servers. Garmin shows the key only once, so keep it private. You can remove it here or revoke it in Garmin Connect at any time.
Leave empty: the phone runs the whole app
Saved. The app uses the instance from the next launch.
Cleared. The app uses the bundled app from the next launch.
An instance URL has to be https.
Your runs and your health data are behind your phone\'s screen lock.
Stride is locked.\n\nYour runs, your physiology and your plans are behind your phone\'s own credential.
Says when Stride has pulled new runs from Garmin.
